description: Wording of spec revision v1.1 for the text output of a verifier (core 20.1.1, section 0 v1.1 row), human decision H1 of 2026-10-15: inclusion proves publication; a valid verdict additionally requires a paid anchor (tx_code == 0); unpaid anchors are an operator funding failure, surfaced by the escrow alert. Each entry gives the meaning and advice a v1.1 verifier prints instead of the strings in replaces, which stay byte-identical in their frozen file. Name, group, checks, cases and every outcome are those of the frozen file.

reasons.name: anchor_unpaid
reasons.meaning: Anchor included, non-zero result code: published, but a valid verdict requires a paid anchor (tx_code == 0). Pending reference, no evidence inside the window, and an absence proof shows a PFF candidate at a height of [h0, anchor_deadline] whose result code is proven non-zero, with no height showing one with code 0. Names the first such height. Permanent: never invalid.
reasons.advice: none (unpaid anchor: operator funding failure, surfaced by the escrow alert); another archive copy or --absence-source if a paid anchor may sit at a height not proven
